s: This article details the refactoring of a monolithic `server.py` file by externalizing logging functions into a dedicated module (`imports/server_logging.py`), emphasizing a philosophy of reducing code surface area and preferring Python-centric web frameworks like FastHTML over JSON-heavy ones like FastAPI.
sub: Philosophy of reducing web framework surface area (FastHTML vs. FastAPI)
Refactoring `server.py` by externalizing logging and display functions
Using Vim for precise search/replace and namespacing during refactoring
Over-the-wire HTML as a modern web development approach
